cases.refreshed: Our pilot program meets every other Saturday at 7:45 a.m. in Guadalupe Gardens just north of the Spring St. Cul de sac off Coleman Avenue across from Target. (Google Maps directions here; see red pin on map below.) If the weather is good, we clean the park until approximately 9:15 a.m., unhoused neighbors receive stipends, then everyone enjoys a vibrant and growing community resource fair until ~10:30 a.m.
